penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Actual file migration and sync tooling requires configuring, running, and troubleshooting software on the customer's Windows Server environment — this is per-customer manual work that cannot be automated by Claude prompts or a landing page.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: IT migration projects typically require scoping calls, environment assessment, and hands-on support — not self-serve, asynchronous delivery.

rationale: The buyer is real and identifiable — IT administrators and MSPs managing Microsoft 365 migrations — and paid tools already exist (ShareGate, Mover), confirming willingness to pay at business prices. However, this is fundamentally a software-plus-services product: the actual migration tool must run inside the customer's Windows environment, which cannot be delivered by Claude prompts or a web service. Every customer engagement requires environment-specific configuration, long-path edge-case handling, and troubleshooting — this is per-customer manual fulfillment work. The factory cannot build or operate this without Youval doing hands-on technical work for each client, making it a consulting engagement disguised as a product. Drop and redirect attention to opportunities the factory can actually build and run autonomously.
solution_plan: This is a Windows File Server to SharePoint Online migration/sync tool. Honestly, a solo non-technical operator cannot build or maintain this: the core product is a Windows application or agent that runs in the customer's server environment, handles edge cases like long file paths and timestamp preservation, and manages incremental sync state — none of which can be assembled from Claude prompts and a Stripe link. Existing competitors (ShareGate, Mover, Synology tools) require engineering teams to build and maintain. Even a reseller or affiliate model around an existing tool would require technical onboarding support per client. This opportunity does not fit the factory's autonomous-delivery model and should be dropped.
notes: Fails build_gates: buildability_with_ai=2 (min 6), operational_autonomy=2 (min 7). Total after penalties is 2.0 — below validate threshold. Fundamental mismatch with autonomous factory model; this is a technical services product.
